meta.text: And the analysis ties it together: cost equals workers times billed hours times rate, plus fixed overhead. On very short runs the fixed term dominates — which is exactly the pitfall the exam builds around. Remember the four common traps from the description: don't use max workers instead of the average under autoscaling, don't ignore startup cost on short runs, and never assume task count equals parallelism without checking for skew. Let's move on to comparing compute choices.
